name: inspect-hostility
author: collinthefarmer@gmail.com
description: Light brightens as the current combat target closes. distance(@target, @position) is in game units, so it is mapped to 0..1 over ~1500 units; beyond that, or with no target (hasTarget gates it), the light is off. Tests target, hasTarget and distance().

proximity.note: 1 at contact, fading to 0 by ~1500 units; @hasTarget zeroes it when there is no combat target, where @target reads [0, 0, 0].
